tools.name: list_packs
tools.description: List legacy JSON evaluation artifacts. For versioned ZIP metadata call get_zip_release.

tools.name: find_pack
tools.description: Find relevant affordable pack by matching task tags; no purchase.

tools.name: inspect_pack
tools.description: Inspect metadata and exact delivery digest.

tools.name: get_demo
tools.description: Get a synthetic demo input and output captured by the Windows tools; not live execution.

tools.name: purchase_status
tools.description: Report payment availability. Never initiates payment.

tools.name: check_brief_free
tools.description: Run a real deterministic completeness check on your own project brief. No charge. No verification of truth or feasibility.

tools.name: get_demand_signals
tools.description: Get recent official French BOAMP notice references relevant to the catalog; not qualified leads. Automatically hides stale and expired results.

tools.name: get_zip_release
tools.description: Get metadata for the forthcoming versioned downloadable ZIP products (different from the legacy JSON evaluation artifacts). Shows exact digest, price, status and checkout page. No payment is initiated.

tools.name: check_records_free
tools.description: Validate a small JSON array of tabular records for missing fields, unexpected fields, blank values and duplicate keys. Bounded read-only audit, no external calls or returned cell contents.
